question: Can a connected role-preserving two-level mesh hierarchy with complete positive smoothed prolongation remain sparse and inexpensive on the four previously fixed TRAIN geometries?

adoption.override: Only existing prepared/cached members below. Recover named5 member masks from exact zero Euclidean input distances; use hard mass restriction, not optional smoothed restriction. Explicit P nnz/cached-bytes safety bounds, no automatic repair or expansion.

scope.selection: Previously fixed four TRAIN CADs in notes/geobc_query_learning_plan.json, not newly ranked by model/GT errors.
scope.execution: CPU SciPy CSR and deterministic topology traversal; this small static preparation is not a GPU training run.

data.prepared_use: Only normalized xyz, exact BC flags0:7 and geometry/alignment scalars. Loading the features member also decompresses its other input columns; no target members are accessed.
data.gradient_use: Explicit member access only, never load_gradient_cache because that helper loads the reference strain member.
data.identity: Freeze small manifest/split/source SHA and selected source stat identities in metadata-only request_contract. Check selected cache node count/xyz SHA/normalization against prepared. Existing H5/source mapping/order provenance remains metadata; do not reopen source arrays or targets.
data.node_order: Canonical original H5 vertices, GRID-coordinate-aligned input order, not GRID_ID-1.
data.roles: Validate features[:,0:7] exactly0/1. signature=sum_b(2**b*flag_b). Preserve all six SPC bits and load member bit, no thresholded average.
data.named_interfaces: Each of four support masks and one loaded mask is exactly euclidean[:,j]==0.0. No numerical tolerance or role expansion. Compare their counts to existing input manifest, support union to any of flags0:6 and loaded mask to flag6; retain separate group counts at both hard levels even if signatures coincide.
data.no_labels: Prepared displacement/stress, gradient reference_cell_tensor_strain, any learned predictions or caches, val/dia/final fields and sample-ID embeddings forbidden.

graph.node_set: All original nodes, including six mids per TETRA10
graph.edges: For each corresponding mid column4..9, insert (corner_a,mid),(mid,corner_b); unique sorted undirected pairs; validate valid indices/no duplicate nodes within a cell.
graph.W0: Symmetric binary adjacency on unique real subedges, diagonal0. Do not reuse existing path-length costs as W0.
graph.edge_geometry: Store separate sorted undirected endpoint pairs, normalized displacement xyz[j]-xyz[i] and positive length/L. Not stiffness or guessed rigid/RBE shortcuts.
graph.m0: Accumulate each positive finite cached corner-P1 cell volume V/10 onto its ten source nodes. Require every node positive mass; sum(m0)=sum(V). This is an input-volume proxy, not quadratic consistent/lumped mass or exact curved volume.
graph.zero_degree: Report components/isolates. Positive-mass genuine isolated nodes form singleton hard aggregates and identity smoothing; zero-mass or invalid/uncovered source node blocks. No geometry reconnect.

hierarchy.algorithm: Deterministic bounded FIFO BFS at each level. growth_size=max(1,ceil(N_level/soft_target)). Use sorted CSR neighbors; seed minimum original-descendant ID unassigned. Discover/assign/enqueue only unassigned same-signature actual neighbors, stopping at growth_size admitted vertices. Admitted frontier vertices remain assigned when growth stops. Repeat to cover all nodes, renumber by minimum original-descendant ID. No RNG, merging, nearest reassignment, shortcut or role relaxation.
hierarchy.connectivity_witness: Store BFS parent/source-descendant minimum IDs. Each admitted vertex has an earlier same-owner parent joined by an actual edge; seed parent points to itself. Validate complete/disjoint ownership and role homogeneity, report parent connectivity proof and aggregate sizes.
hierarchy.role_component_lower_bound: At each level count connected components of every exact-role induced subgraph before aggregation. Sum lower-bounds group count. If lower bound or actual count exceeds hard maximum, record blocked evidence and stop; no automatic budget increase.
hierarchy.G0_G1: One-hot hard owners (N0->N1,N1->N2), one nonempty owner per node
hierarchy.W1: G0.T @ W0 @ G0; remove diagonal only. Positive off-diagonal integer cut-edge multiplicity, no binarizing or centroid-neighbor replacement.
hierarchy.W2: G1.T @ W1 @ G1; remove diagonal only, retain multiplicities.
hierarchy.hard_mass_positions_roles: m1=G0.T m0; x1=diag(m1)^-1 G0.T diag(m0)x0, m2/x2 analogously. Hard exact roles inherited; named5 counts add along owners.
hierarchy.R01: diag(m1)^-1 @ G0.T @ diag(m0), shape[N1,N0], exactly one positive entry per original node before grouping, row sums1
hierarchy.R12: diag(m2)^-1 @ G1.T @ diag(m1), shape[N2,N1], row sums1; hard restriction selected, optional smoothed R not used.

prolongation.J: For each level0/1 with d=W*1>0, J=(1/3)I+(2/3)diag(d)^-1 W. Isolated row Jii=1. Nonnegative row-stochastic.
prolongation.construction: Complete FP64 CSR; coalesce duplicate paths/sort indices, remove exactzeros only. No dense N0xN1, top-k, threshold, support clipping or unannounced row renormalization.
prolongation.storage: Float32 CSR values, int64 indices/indptr; report FP64 build and FP32 saved row-sum errors, finite/nonnegative support and constant reproduction. Float32 tolerance1e-6; FP64 tolerance1e-12.
prolongation.over_limit: Blocked evidence, retain existing completed CAD outputs; no fallback/factorization or truncation automatically.
prolongation.role_mixing: Smoothing can cross role boundaries along real edges. Hard ownership remains homogeneous and original query BC inputs remain available; this is not hard BC constraint enforcement.
prolongation.physical_limit: Only nodal constant preservation established. No affine/rigid preservation, C1/bandlimit, exact elasticity, global receptive field or P1 accuracy guarantee.

output.format: Atomic immutable per-CAD plain NPZ with owners/BFS parent/roles/named5counts/masses/centroids, real edge geometry, W0/W1/W2/P01/P12/R01/R12 CSR arrays and scalar identities; small manifest, summary/status/config.
output.readout: N0/N1/N2, graph/role component counts and isolates, aggregate coverage/connectedness/homogeneity, quotient symmetry/positive weights, source count conservation, mass conservation, P/R full supports and row sums, constant reproduction, P role mixing, actual per-step runtimes/cache bytes and peak RSS.
output.resume: Reuse only completed CAD outputs whose complete contract and file identities match. Preserve completed files on failure; strict contract on summary reuse. No optimizer/model exists.
output.formal_result: notes/geobc_topology_context_feasibility_result.json after all four complete or a predeclared scientific safety condition is actually reached. Summary status=completed/feasibility_pass=false/outcome=infeasible records the latter with completed/blocked/untouched CAD lists and exact evidence; it does not claim all caches prepared. Exceptions/missing/corrupt inputs are statusfailed, never a completed scientific rejection.

checks.author_fixture: One synthetic CPU fixture covers known TETRA10 subedge ordering, connected role BFS/quotient, positive J/P/R/constant preservation and an isolated identity case. No actual arrays or CUDA before parent review.
checks.parent_review: One independent focused source/interface review and root release. Do not rerun author's fixture or native validation.
checks.runtime_acceptance: All four TRAIN caches satisfy predeclared invariants and safety bounds. Report actual overhead, not extrapolated training speed.

after.if_pass: Root freezes one small matched TRAIN4 known-load1000 endpoint neighbor-vs-self pilot after measured input sparsity/cost. Replace query32, keep same original43/global32/coarse8/native144/9basis; all stored params/init/recipe/case RNG matched. Its architecture and numeric utility gates are not selected by this input plan.
after.if_blocked: Use actual fragmentation/density/runtime evidence to select one minimal follow-up; do not sweep budgets or silently relax roles.
after.continuous_scope: Original-node input pilot only. Future arbitrary-point context requires shared all10 TETRA10 shape interpolation and physical curved-map inversion; signed quadratic weights allowed. Entire raw43 off-node definition remains unresolved.

novelty: Connected mesh hierarchy, Jacobi smoothing, mass restriction and message passing are established mechanisms. This stage tests a GeoBC interface/cost hypothesis; no new algorithm or generalization success claim.
